findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 2 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 17 questions numbered 1-17; by section: 2.1.2 4, 2.1.4 4, 2.2.1 1, 2.2.2 1, 2.2.3 3, 2.3 1, 2.4 1, 2.5 2.

17 five-mark questions in book order: values of a function, domain and range (rational, square-root and always-positive denominators), proofs of one-to-one / onto / bijective and their counter-examples, a piecewise function, intersections of a line with the axes, of two lines and of a line with a parabola (two points, tangent, no point), square-root and cube-root graphs from tables, exponential growth with doubling time, and a decay model. New functions and numbers; none repeats the unit's exercises or examples. The range of a shifted square root follows the book correction (y >= c). Every step was checked by computation (sympy, check2_long.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
